scope: Collider rule constants only. Old and new dumps have identical reviewed method code, direct callee identities, the constant calculations referenced immutable data, layouts and enums. No game execution; generated relations still require the ID in the entry own RCOL.
supportBoundary: Direct anonymous runtime helpers use bounded one-level code identities; their runtime data, nested anonymous target identities and runtime effects are explicitly outside this constant guard. Four leaf routines have manually closed control flow and explicit lookup-table proofs. This is not a general game-version migration system.
